{"code": "from ast import literal_eval

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the conversion worked
print("First few converted revenues:", df['revenue_numeric'].head().tolist())

# Apply filters: loyal customers AND completed status
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the resulting population
print("Number of loyal completed orders:", len(df_loyal_completed))

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
